ownRead.statement:
## E03 — Independent trapping and manipulation of microparticles using dexterous acoustic tweezers

**experiment · component · claims C3.**

**Reported result:** A phased ultrasonic array independently traps and manipulates microparticles; reported examples include 45 and 90 micrometre spheres.

**Already supplied:** An engineered transducer array, liquid medium and pre-existing particles are required.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** This particular experiment supports microscale manipulation, not a claim of nanoscale performance or a universal size–frequency law.

**Source:** Courtney et al. (2014), *Applied Physics Letters 104, 154103*. [DOI: 10.1063/1.4870489](https://doi.org/10.1063/1.4870489).

**Verification coverage:** Author-institution records and original-paper abstract; not a full methods or data audit. Checked 2026-10-02.
